```python
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, Descriptors, rdMolDescriptors
from pyscf import gto, dft
import numpy as np, os
sf='[C][C][C][C][Branch1][=Branch2][C][N][Branch1][Ring2][C][Ring1][Ring2][C][O]'
sm='CCCC1(CN(C1)C)O'
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(sm))
AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m, randomSeed=20250308, useRandomCoords=True)
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m, maxIters=1000)
conf=m.GetConformer()
syms=[]; coords=[]
for a in m.GetAtoms():
    syms.append(a.GetSymbol()); p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx()); coords.append([p.x,p.y,p.z])
xyz='; '.join(f'{s} {x:.10f} {y:.10f} {z:.10f}' for s,(x,y,z) in zip(syms,coords))
mol=gto.M(atom=xyz, basis='6-31g*', charge=0, spin=0, verbose=0)
mf=dft.RKS(mol); mf.xc='B3LYP'; mf.conv_tol=1e-9; mf.max_cycle=200
energy=mf.kernel()
mo=np.asarray(mf.mo_energy); occ=np.asarray(mf.mo_occ)
occidx=np.where(occ>0)[0]
hidx=int(occidx[-1]); lidx=hidx+1
print('SELFIES:', sf)
print('SMILES:', sm)
print('Formula:', rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(Chem.RemoveHs(m)))
print('Atoms:', mol.natm, 'Electrons:', mol.nelectron)
print('SCF converged:', mf.converged)
print('Method: B3LYP/6-31G* single point on RDKit MMFF conformer')
print('Total energy (Ha):', f'{energy:.12f}')
print('HOMO index:', hidx+1)
print('HOMO energy (Ha):', f'{mo[hidx]:.12f}')
print('LUMO energy (Ha):', f'{mo[lidx]:.12f}')
print('Gap (Ha):', f'{mo[lidx]-mo[hidx]:.12f}')
```
